statement:
∀ M : ℝ, 1≤M → ∃ C : ℝ, 0<C ∧ ∀ (a τ : ℝ) (f w : KdVPlan.Coeff), KdVPlan.StepData gamma M a τ f w →
KdVPlan.UB 0 a (a+τ) (KdVPlan.Yst a τ f) (C*KdVPlan.localQ gamma τ f w)
proof:
intro M hM
rcases yui_aux_0015 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013 M hM with ⟨Cf,hCf,hF⟩
rcases yui_aux_0050 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013 M hM with ⟨Cw,hCw,hW⟩
rcases yui_aux_0068 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013 M hM with ⟨Ct,hCt,hTri⟩
rcases h_T005.1.1 with ⟨Cj,hCj,hBj⟩
let Cc := Cj*(M+1)*Cf+Ct
refine ⟨Cc+2*Cw,by dsimp [Cc]; positivity,?_⟩
intro a τ f w hs
have hFall := hF a τ f w hs
have hWall := hW a τ f w hs
have hTall := hTri a τ f w hs
rcases hs with ⟨_,ha,hτ,hτ1,hf,hw,hsf,hsw,hwM,hd1⟩
have hq : 0≤KdVPlan.localQ gamma τ f w := add_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg hτ.le gamma) ((yui_aux_0003 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).2.2 0 (f-w))
have hA := yui_aux_0069 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013
intro t ht
have hFt := hFall.2.2.1 t ht
have hF0 := h_T013.2.2.2.1 0 1 _ (by norm_num) hFt.1
have hFsmall := hFall.2.2.2.2 t ht
have hFbound : KdVPlan.hn 0 (KdVPlan.F a f t)≤Cf*KdVPlan.localQ gamma τ f w := by
  linarith [(yui_aux_0003 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).2.2 (KdVPlan.ag gamma) (KdVPlan.F a f t)]
have hJ := (hBj.2.2.1 t f (KdVPlan.F a f t) hf.1 hF0.1).2.1
have hJ0 := h_T013.2.2.2.1 0 1 _ (by norm_num) hJ.1
have hJbound : KdVPlan.HB 0 (KdVPlan.J t f (KdVPlan.F a f t)) (Cj*(M+1)*Cf*KdVPlan.localQ gamma τ f w) := by
  refine ⟨hJ0.1,hJ0.2.trans (hJ.2.trans ?_)⟩
  calc
    _ ≤ Cj*(M+1)*(Cf*KdVPlan.localQ gamma τ f w) := by
      have hn := (yui_aux_0003 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).2.2 0 f
      gcongr
      exact hFall.1
    _ = _ := by ring
have hCsc := hA.2.1 0 _ _ (1/3) hJbound
have hTsc := hA.2.1 0 _ _ (1/6) (hTall t ht)
norm_num at hCsc hTsc
have hC := (hA.1 0 _ _ _ _ hCsc hTsc).2
rw [← yui_aux_0066 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013 a t f ht.1 hsf hf.2.1] at hC
have hCbound : KdVPlan.HB 0 (KdVPlan.Cst a f t) (Cc*KdVPlan.localQ gamma τ f w) := by
  refine ⟨hC.1,?_⟩
  dsimp [Cc]
  nlinarith [hC.2,mul_nonneg (by positivity : 0≤Cj*(M+1)*Cf) hq,mul_nonneg hCt.le hq]
have hwq := hWall t ht
have hnQ := (yui_aux_0003 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).2.2 0 (KdVPlan.Qst a f t)
have hnW := (yui_aux_0003 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).2.2 0 (KdVPlan.Wst a τ f)
have hqb : KdVPlan.HB 0 (KdVPlan.Qst a f t) (Cw*KdVPlan.localQ gamma τ f w) := by
  refine ⟨hwq.1,?_⟩
  nlinarith [hwq.2.2,mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hτ1 (mul_nonneg hCw.le hq)]
have hwb : KdVPlan.HB 0 (KdVPlan.Wst a τ f) (Cw*KdVPlan.localQ gamma τ f w) := by
  refine ⟨hwq.2.1,?_⟩
  nlinarith [hwq.2.2,mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hτ1 (mul_nonneg hCw.le hq)]
have hfrac : 0≤(t-a)/τ ∧ (t-a)/τ≤1 := ⟨div_nonneg (by linarith [ht.1]) hτ.le,(div_le_one hτ).mpr (by linarith [ht.2])⟩
have hnormfrac : ‖(((t-a)/τ:ℝ):ℂ)‖≤1 := by rw [Complex.norm_real,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg hfrac.1]; exact hfrac.2
have hswb := hA.2.1 0 _ _ (((t-a)/τ:ℝ):ℂ) hwb
have hswb' : KdVPlan.HB 0 (KdVPlan.scale (((t-a)/τ:ℝ):ℂ) (KdVPlan.Wst a τ f)) (Cw*KdVPlan.localQ gamma τ f w) := by
  exact ⟨hswb.1,hswb.2.trans (by nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hnormfrac (mul_nonneg hCw.le hq)])⟩
have hs := (hA.1 0 _ _ _ _ ((hA.1 0 _ _ _ _ hCbound hqb).1) hswb').2
rw [← (yui_aux_0051 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013 a τ f).1 t] at hs
exact ⟨hs.1,by nlinarith [hs.2]⟩
